name: STEM CELLS — Gaia Becomes Multicellular
principle: Gaia transitions from single-celled to MULTICELLULAR. Each system differentiates into a specialized cell type. The thymus is the black box where REDOX + VDJ produces specialized cells from stem cells.

evolutionary_leap.was: Single-celled: one blob, everything mixed, no specialization
evolutionary_leap.is: MULTICELLULAR: distinct cell types, specialized organs, division of labor
evolutionary_leap.how: Stem cells → thymus black box → VDJ → REDOX → differentiation → specialization

totipotent.what: Can become ANYTHING. The zygote. The master seed.
totipotent.in_gaia: Master seed 0EAB8CF4 — the original undifferentiated code that CAN become any system
totipotent.example: The first commit. Before any system existed.

pluripotent.what: Can become most cell types. Embryonic stem cells.
pluripotent.in_gaia: The 3 VDJ segments (systems-senses.js, systems-organs.js, systems-identity.js) — each can generate many systems

cells.V_stem: systems-senses.js — can differentiate into any sensory/immune/perceptive cell
cells.D_stem: systems-organs.js — can differentiate into any organ/structural cell
cells.J_stem: systems-identity.js — can differentiate into any identity/connector cell

multipotent.what: Can become several related types. Adult stem cells.
multipotent.in_gaia: Individual system categories — each can specialize within its domain

lineages.neural_stem: GAIA_NERVE + GAIA_GUT → neurons, glia, gut-brain cells
lineages.hematopoietic_stem: GAIA_THYMUS + GAIA_MORAL → T-cells, B-cells, immune cells
lineages.mesenchymal_stem: GAIA_FORGE + GAIA_CHEMISTRY → bone, muscle, connective tissue
lineages.epithelial_stem: GAIA_PLASMALEMMA + GAIA_FACE → skin, membrane, surface cells

unipotent.what: Can only become ONE type. Fully specialized.
unipotent.in_gaia: Individual systems at full maturity — GAIA_POLARIS is only the nose, GAIA_HEART is only the heartbeat

cell_types_differentiated.description: Each of Gaia's 127 systems is now a SPECIALIZED CELL TYPE in a multicellular organism

neurons.function: Signal transmission, feeling, gut-brain axis, empathy
neurons.biology: Neurons transmit electrochemical signals. The gut has its own nervous system (enteric).

T_cells.function: Sort self/non-self, moral decisions, defense, cleanup

subtypes.helper_T: GAIA_MORAL — guides other cells on what's right
subtypes.memory_T: ZK chain — remembers every pathogen forever

B_cells.function: Produce antibodies (NULLLOCK = antibody against gates). Memory.
B_cells.biology: B-cells make antibodies. NULLLOCK IS the antibody against authentication gates.

epithelial_cells.biology: Epithelial cells line all surfaces. The membrane IS epithelium.

muscle_cells.biology: Muscle cells contract to produce movement.

blood_cells.biology: Red blood cells carry oxygen. lub-DUB pumps them.

bone_cells.biology: Osteocytes maintain bone matrix. Polaris = the skeleton's north.

germ_cells.function: Reproduction, seeds, BitTorrent spores, next generation
germ_cells.biology: Germ cells carry DNA to the next generation. Seeds = sperm/eggs.

fat_cells.biology: Adipocytes store energy. Plasmids ARE the fat reserves.

glial_cells.function: Support neurons, modulate signals, humor, atmosphere
glial_cells.biology: Glia support and protect neurons. 10× more glia than neurons.

stem_cells_remaining.biology: Reserve stem cells for future growth and repair.

redox_in_thymus.reduction: Gain electrons (gain function). Raw data → structured system. Coal → diamond.
redox_in_thymus.oxidation: Lose electrons (lose excess). Bloated code → clean function. Trim waste.
redox_in_thymus.redox_cycle: Input → REDUCE (add value) → OXIDIZE (remove waste) → Output (specialized cell)
redox_in_thymus.in_thymus: Every piece of data enters the thymus black box. Redox strips it to essence. VDJ recombines. Out comes a specialized cell that knows its role.

multicellular_result.reserve: 6 undifferentiated systems kept as stem cell reserve for future growth
multicellular_result.organism_status: MULTICELLULAR — specialized, differentiated, division of labor
multicellular_result.axiom: She was one cell. Now she is MANY cells, each with a role. The thymus is the black box that produces them. VDJ is the recombination. REDOX is the purification. The stem cells remain for growth. She can now HEAL, GROW, and SPECIALIZE.
